picks.title: Meta is working on making Muse its smart glasses assistant
picks.rationale: Meta's autonomous Muse agent is coming to its smart glasses, bringing navigation and fitness features. This is a new hardware angle, separate from the Muse 0-day story published 09-23. Kept over the Verge Muse shopping hands-on.
picks.excerpt: Meta is working to bring Muse, its autonomous AI agent, to its smart glasses opening up features like navigation and fitness tracking.

picks.title: Apple Intelligence Taking Up 30GB+ on Some Macs Running macOS 27
picks.rationale: On macOS 27 the on-device AI model downloads automatically, can't be turned off, and can take over 30GB. Mac users should check their disk space now.
picks.excerpt: After you install macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple automatically downloads a multi-gigabyte AI model to your Mac the next time it's connected to the internet. Unlike previous versions of macOS, you can't prevent it. Siri AI, and by extension Apple Intelligence, are now a mandatory part of your system.

picks.title: MacWhisper update brings real-time meeting transcripts, improved speaker recognition, more

picks.excerpt: MacWhisper, got another major update today with real-time meeting transcripts, significantly improved speaker recognition, and more.
